summary: The contract is specific, well-scoped, and fully aligned to the assignment. All 7 acceptance criteria are covered verbatim, files to touch match related_files, planned changes are concrete with no scope creep, and risks are reasonable.
findings: Acceptance checks mirror the assignment criteria exactly — no gaps.
Partial update semantics are called out as a risk, which is appropriate for a PATCH endpoint.
updatedAt flakiness risk is acknowledged — implementation should assert the value changed rather than matching an exact timestamp.
